name: comp-485
title: Filterable Data Table
blurb: Enterprise data table with search, status filters, bulk actions, and column…
description: Full-featured data table with multi-column search (name/email), status filter popover with counts, column visibility toggle, sortable columns, pagination controls, row selection, bulk delete with confirmation, row action menu, and add user…
use_when: Admin panels or dashboards where users need comprehensive table control: search, filter, view customization, bulk…
avoid_when: Simple read-only data display — too many features add unnecessary complexity.
a11y: All buttons have aria-labels. Filters use proper labels. Delete uses AlertDialog for confirmation. Column visibility toggles use checkboxes. Keyboard accessible throughout.
